<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Alpaca Morning Walk</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #a8c9c5;
  }
  body { position: fixed; inset: 0; }
  .scene {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .cloud-one { animation: cloudOne 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .cloud-two { animation: cloudTwo 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .cloud-three { animation: cloudOne 29s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
  .sun-halo { animation: sunlight 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .birds { animation: birds 13s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .sway-slow, .sway-medium, .sway-fast {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: 50% 100%;
  }
  .sway-slow { animation: sway 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .sway-medium { animation: sway 3.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
  .sway-fast { animation: sway 3.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

  .leg .limb, .leg .upper, .leg .shin-light {
    fill: none;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }
  .leg .limb { stroke-width: 11; }
  .leg .upper { stroke-width: 20; }
  .leg .shin-light { stroke-width: 2.4; opacity: .42; }
  .leg.near .limb { stroke: #c99662; }
  .leg.near .upper { stroke: #e9c994; }
  .leg.near .shin-light { stroke: #f4dbb1; }
  .leg.far { opacity: .88; }
  .leg.far .limb { stroke: #aa805c; }
  .leg.far .upper { stroke: #c9aa7d; }
  .leg.far .shin-light { stroke: #ddc39b; }
  .leg .hoof { fill: #654c3e; }
  .leg.far .hoof { fill: #5e5148; }
  .leg .hoof-line {
    fill: none;
    stroke: #aa8b6c;
    stroke-width: 1;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    opacity: .55;
  }

  @keyframes cloudOne {
    from { transform: translate(-12px, 0); }
    to   { transform: translate(20px, 4px); }
  }
  @keyframes cloudTwo {
    from { transform: translate(15px, 2px); }
    to   { transform: translate(-20px, -3px); }
  }
  @keyframes sunlight {
    from { opacity: .48; transform: scale(.97); transform-origin: 1015px 132px; }
    to   { opacity: .75; transform: scale(1.04); transform-origin: 1015px 132px; }
  }
  @keyframes birds {
    from { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    to   { transform: translate(24px, -7px); }
  }
  @keyframes sway {
    from { transform: rotate(-2.2deg); }
    to   { transform: rotate(2.6deg); }
  }
</style>
</head>

    <path d="M1138 696Q1150 687 1167 692Q1173 698 1163 701H1140Z" opacity=".65"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#f0ddb4" stroke-width="2" opacity=".45">
    <path d="M1117 685Q1128 681 1138 685"/>
    <path d="M1145 695Q1153 692 1160 695"/>

  <!-- Gentle atmospheric finish -->
  <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)" pointer-events="none"/>
  <rect width="1280" height="720" filter="url(#paperGrain)" opacity=".035"
        style="mix-blend-mode:multiply" pointer-events="none"/>
</svg>

<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

  const bodyVisual = $("bodyVisual");
  const neckGroup = $("neckGroup");
  const tail = $("tail");
  const tassel = $("tassel");
  const earNear = $("earNear");
  const eye = $("eye");
  const shadow = $("alpacaShadow");

  const cycle = 1.55;
  const stride = 56;
  const stance = 0.65;
  const lift = 24;
  const groundSpeed = stride / (cycle * stance);

  const legs = [
    { id: "leg-fh", x: -70, offset: 0.50, bend: -1, far: true  },
    { id: "leg-ff", x:  91, offset: 0.25, bend:  1, far: true  },
    { id: "leg-nh", x: -94, offset: 0.00, bend: -1, far: false },
    { id: "leg-nf", x:  68, offset: 0.75, bend:  1, far: false }
  ].map(config => {
    const root = $(config.id);
    return Object.assign(config, {
      limb: root.querySelector(".limb"),
      upper: root.querySelector(".upper"),
      shine: root.querySelector(".shin-light"),
      hoof: root.querySelector(".hoof")
    });
  });

  // Deterministic trail marks, continuously moving at the feet's stance speed.
  let seed = 41;
  const random = () => {
    seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
  };
  const mod = (n, m) => ((n % m) + m) % m;
  const flow = $("groundFlow");
  const trailMarks = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, "path");
    const length = 4 + random() * 11;
    if (i % 3 === 0) {
      el.setAttribute("d", `M${-length / 2} 0Q0 ${-1.5 - random() * 2} ${length / 2} 0`);
      el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      el.setAttribute("stroke", i % 2 ? "#9d8964" : "#f2e2bb");
      el.setAttribute("stroke-width", (1 + random() * 1.3).toFixed(2));
      el.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
    } else {
      el.setAttribute("d", `M${-length / 2} 0q${length / 2} -3 ${length} 0q${-length / 2} 3 ${-length} 0Z`);
      el.setAttribute("fill", i % 2 ? "#aa946d" : "#ead8af");
      el.setAttribute("opacity", (.35 + random() * .35).toFixed(2));
    }
    flow.appendChild(el);
    trailMarks.push({
      el,
      x: random() * 1400,
      y: 566 + random() * 126,
      rotation: -8 + random() * 16
    });
  }

  function updateLeg(config, gait, sway, bob, roll) {
    const p = mod(gait + config.offset, 1);
    let stepX, footY, hoofPitch;

    if (p < stance) {
      const q = p / stance;
      stepX = stride * (0.5 - q);
      footY = config.far ? -2 : 0;
      hoofPitch = 0;
    } else {
      const q = (p - stance) / (1 - stance);
      const ease = q * q * (3 - 2 * q);
      const arc = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * q), 1.3);
      stepX = stride * (-0.5 + ease);
      footY = (config.far ? -2 : 0) - lift * arc;
      hoofPitch = -10 * Math.sin(Math.PI * q) + 3 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * q);
    }

    // Match each hip to the gently rolling body while feet remain on the trail.
    const angle = roll * Math.PI / 180;
    const c = Math.cos(angle);
    const s = Math.sin(angle);
    const baseY = -119;
    const relativeY = baseY + 170;
    const hipX = config.x * c - relativeY * s + sway;
    const hipY = -170 + config.x * s + relativeY * c + bob;

    const footX = config.x + stepX;
    const dx = footX - hipX;
    const dy = footY - hipY;
    const rawDistance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const upperLength = 65;
    const lowerLength = 65;
    const distance = Math.max(8, Math.min(rawDistance, upperLength + lowerLength - 0.1));
    const ux = dx / rawDistance;
    const uy = dy / rawDistance;

    const along = (
      upperLength * upperLength -
      lowerLength * lowerLength +
      distance * distance
    ) / (2 * distance);
    const out = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, upperLength * upperLength - along * along));

    const kneeX = hipX + along * ux + config.bend * out * (-uy);
    const kneeY = hipY + along * uy + config.bend * out * ux;
    const upperEndX = hipX + (kneeX - hipX) * 0.9;
    const upperEndY = hipY + (kneeY - hipY) * 0.9;

    config.limb.setAttribute("d",
      `M${hipX.toFixed(2)} ${hipY.toFixed(2)}L${kneeX.toFixed(2)} ${kneeY.toFixed(2)}L${footX.toFixed(2)} ${footY.toFixed(2)}`);
    config.upper.setAttribute("d",
      `M${hipX.toFixed(2)} ${hipY.toFixed(2)}L${upperEndX.toFixed(2)} ${upperEndY.toFixed(2)}`);
    config.shine.setAttribute("d",
      `M${(kneeX - 1.5).toFixed(2)} ${(kneeY + 4).toFixed(2)}L${(footX - 1.5).toFixed(2)} ${(footY - 7).toFixed(2)}`);
    config.hoof.setAttribute("transform",
      `translate(${footX.toFixed(2)} ${footY.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${hoofPitch.toFixed(2)})`);
  }

  function draw(time) {
    const gait = time / cycle;
    const phase = gait * Math.PI * 2;

    const bob = -1 + 1.8 * Math.cos(phase * 2);
    const sway = 2.1 * Math.sin(phase);
    const roll = 0.58 * Math.sin(phase + 0.5);
    const neckNod = 0.85 * Math.sin(phase * 2 + 1.15);
    const tailSwish = 4 * Math.sin(phase - 0.8) + 1.2 * Math.sin(phase * 2);

    bodyVisual.setAttribute("transform",
      `translate(${sway.toFixed(2)} ${bob.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${roll.toFixed(3)} 0 -170)`);
    neckGroup.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${neckNod.toFixed(3)} 75 -178)`);
    tail.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${tailSwish.toFixed(2)} -116 -197)`);
    tassel.setAttribute("transform",
      `rotate(${(7 * Math.sin(phase + 0.7)).toFixed(2)} 126 -282)`);

    const earTime = time % 7.2;
    const twitch = earTime < 0.55
      ? Math.sin(earTime / 0.55 * Math.PI * 2) * (1 - earTime / 0.55) * 5
      : 0;
    earNear.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${twitch.toFixed(2)} 121 -383)`);

    const blinkTime = time % 5.4;
    let eyeOpen = 1;
    if (blinkTime > 5.05) {
      const q = (blinkTime - 5.05) / 0.24;
      eyeOpen = q < 0.5 ? 1 - q * 2 : (q - 0.5) * 2;
      eyeOpen = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(1, eyeOpen));
    }
    eye.setAttribute("transform", `translate(139 -369) scale(1 ${eyeOpen.toFixed(3)})`);

    legs.forEach(leg => updateLeg(leg, gait, sway, bob, roll));

    shadow.setAttribute("rx", (136 - bob * 2.2).toFixed(2));
    shadow.setAttribute("opacity", (0.225 + bob * 0.008).toFixed(3));

    const distance = time * groundSpeed;
    trailMarks.forEach(mark => {
      const x = mod(mark.x - distance + 70, 1400) - 70;
      mark.el.setAttribute("transform",
        `translate(${x.toFixed(2)} ${mark.y.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${mark.rotation.toFixed(2)})`);
    });
  }

  draw(0);
  const start = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    draw((now - start) / 1000);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
